annotations.text:
Option C — express, engaging, simple. Five screens instead of six: confirm + payment merge into one Start screen (two taps from scan to charging), and returning drivers get a one-tap Quick Start that reuses their last charger and payment method. Engagement is one element per screen: range added + ETA on Live, range + CO₂ avoided on Receipt, km-on-charge on History. Palette matches Option A (cool off-white ground, teal accent, copper money figures) on C's simplified structure; Bricolage Grotesque / Instrument Sans / Space Mono.
Same amounts as Options A and B: ₱48.50/kWh, 18.4 kWh → ₱892.40 captured, ₱607.60 released.
